name: Omifco SAOG
hq: Qalhat / Sur / South Al Sharqiyah Governorate
description: Oman India Fertiliser Company SAOG (OMIFCO) operates a world-scale ammonia and granulated urea manufacturing complex at Sur Industrial Estate in Qalhat, Oman, converting domestic natural gas into high-purity fertiliser for global and local agricultural markets. Commencing commercial operations in July 2005, its integrated four-plant coastal complex includes dedicated utilities, off-site infrastructure, and an export jetty operating continuously from a central control room. Originally founded as an Oman-India joint venture, OMIFCO is backed by OQ SAOC (37.50%), IFFCO (18.75%), and KRIBHCO (18.75%) following a 25% public secondary offering in July 2026. Exported granular urea generates over 90% of total sales, complemented by merchant ammonia exports and domestic urea supply.
highlights: 9M 2026 revenue grew 16% YoY to OMR 259.5M with net profit rising 7% to OMR 99.4M on higher urea and ammonia netbacks and above-plan production.
Achieved 26.70 million LTI-free man-hours as of 30 September 2026 with zero Lost Time Injuries recorded since 2019.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 308.90M and Net Profit of OMR 123.50M (Total Assets: OMR 410.42M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 49,494 registered shareholders • Omani 54.1% | GCC 7.2% | Foreign & Arab 38.6% (3 disclosed 5%+ holders).
